summary: Sprite sheets for the spaceport pack. Every frame is edited at generation resolution from the still's own recovered source and composited back onto it inside a mask, then all frames are downscaled once on the still's sampling grid. Frame 0 of every sheet is the shipped still, pixel for pixel.
composite: pixels inside the hard mask replace the source at 1024x1024; the latent mask alone is not enough, since VAE decoding drifts thousands of pixels outside it
downscale: Pillow NEAREST's own accumulating sample walk over the still's recorded alpha bounds, extended by whole cells for padding; a closed-form (i+0.5)*step disagrees with Pillow at exact-integer columns

sources.master: conformed_from.sha256 of the still's manifest entry; recovered from the worker by its cutout receipt filename and verified against that hash

blink.prompt: Close both of his eyes completely: each upper eyelid meets its lower eyelid, and no white or pupil of either eye is visible. Keep his eyebrows, mustache, face shape, skin colour, palette and pixel-art rendering exactly the same. Change nothing else.

call.prompt: He attacks: he thrusts his staff straight forward to the left, held level at chest height with his arm extended, the tip pointing at an opponent on the left, like a fencer's lunge. The staff is a single straight rod held in one hand. Keep his face, crest, coat, boots, stance, palette and pixel-art rendering exactly the same. Plain flat light grey background, no motion lines.

response.prompt: He raises his staff to parry a blow: he grips the staff in both hands and holds it diagonally across the front of his chest, the tip angled up and to the left, like a fencer on guard. Keep his face, crest, coat, boots, stance, palette and pixel-art rendering exactly the same. Plain flat light grey background, no motion lines.
